label: Riser Doors
manufacturer: Simplis — The Access Panel Company Ltd
summary: Fire-rated steel access doors to service risers and shafts.
construction: Steel skins to both faces over an insulated strengthened core, 100 mm thick. Door tray and frame in 1.0 and 1.2 mm Zintec electro-galvanised mild steel. Quick-release heavy-duty pivot hinges welded into the door trays. Multiple-point locking to the active leaf.
_PROVISIONAL: CONFIRM BEFORE ISSUE. Taken from the Simplis Christo Riser Door literature. The overall envelope (4169 x 2755 mm, up to 6 leaves), the option lists, the acoustic figures and the standards are all from that literature and are sound. What is NOT known is which width band each leaf count covers — the sizeBands below split the envelope evenly as a placeholder and must be replaced with the real orderable ranges. Also unconfirmed: whether E and EI classifications are offered on riser doors (the literature evidences EW120 for riser doors; E120 and EI60 are quoted for access panels, a different product), and whether periods below 120 are orderable. Product codes follow the classification seen on the door label (EW120S) but the ordering format needs confirming.

clearOpening.note: Clear opening is the structural opening less 201 mm on width and 75 mm on height.

structuralAllowance.note: Prepare the structural opening 16 mm larger than the ordered door. The FrameSmart system gives 10 mm of in-frame adjustment, so no packers or mastic are needed.

fireClassificationNote: EW adds control of radiated heat to integrity, reducing the risk of fire spreading by radiation and allowing safer passage past an open riser door on an escape route. Christo Riser Doors are bi-directionally tested to EW120.

options.label: Handing
options.note: Viewed from the access side. For multi-leaf sets this is the active leaf.
